name: Ristorante Luna Rossa
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant Luna Rossa in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the **Alps** at **Restaurant Luna Rossa** in **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming spot offers a cozy atmosphere with a focus on fresh, regional ingredients.

Indulge in classic dishes like **Spaghetti alla Bolognese**, **Risotto ai Funghi**, or our famous **Tiramisù**. For a taste of **Tirol**, try our seasonal specialties, such as **Kaiserschmarrn** with local berries or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**.

Perfect for a romantic dinner, a family meal, or a business lunch, **Luna Rossa** combines Italian flair with Alpine hospitality. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in the **Stubaier Alpen**, or simply enjoying the scenic beauty of **Tirol**, this restaurant is a must-visit.

Reservations recommended—especially on weekends! **Buon appetito!**
